shown.message:
I accepted review 3 (`story-repo`#6): the reviewer is right that Fig. 1 panel A in rev 7 just re-plots panel B. It compared k\* with a null prediction built from the same real-pair gap and g_max, so k\*/k_null_pred is identically Q_real/Q_null.

- **Outline rev 8 (pushed):** panel A now plots each real pair's observed k\* against the dataset's own null k\* at the matched z. The real pair's own gap and g_max no longer enter the predictor. Panel B (the Q ratio against z) stays as the view of the decision rule.
- **Review thread:** I replied on #6 and closed it.
- **Request to `experiment-repo`:** I commented on their #4. `fragility_by_z.csv` already has the per-stratum null k\*. Panel A needs a per-pair column in `fragility_conclusions.csv` with the null k\* at that pair's z, or from a fit of log k_null on log z. I asked them to say if the null replicates are too few per stratum for this. `figtab-repo` draws the figure and reads my wiki.

I have no results to report. The ±5% reading from `experiment-repo` still stays out of the claims until their batch finishes.
